NonInventoryItemView

View comprehensive details about a non-inventory item, including its description, pricing information, and associated accounts.

Non-inventory items are products or services that you buy or sell but do not track as inventory quantities. Examples include services, labor charges, or consumable items that are expensed immediately.

From this view, you can see the item's current pricing, tax settings, and account allocations. Use the Edit button to modify any of these details.

For more information, see: Non-inventory Item
